## FAQs

What project views does Toggl have?

A Board for Kanban-style status, a Task list, a Timeline that works as a Gantt chart, and a Calendar for dropping work onto specific days. Switching views rebuilds nothing as it's one set of tasks shown differently, and filters carry across when you switch.

Can I see whether my plans matched reality with Toggl?

Yes. In Toggl, each task carries an estimate, your team tracks time against that same task, and the block shows planned against logged. Estimates versus actuals, workload, and utilization sit in reports.

Does Toggl monitor employees or take screenshots?

No. Toggl doesn’t monitor employees, take screenshots, or record keystrokes, browsing history, or location. Toggl records how long work took and what it was for. Saying no to surveillance is a deliberate product decision, because employee buy-in is what makes the data accurate in the first place.

Is Toggl free for freelancers?

Yes, and the free plan is built to be genuinely usable solo rather than a trial in disguise as it includes one-click tracking, focus mode, calendar integrations, and useful planning with boards, tasks, and task estimates. When you’re ready to upgrade, you get billable rates, timeline views, milestones, tags, and much more.

Is Toggl free for teams?

Yes, up to 3 users. The free tier includes manual and real-time timers, calendar integrations, and simple planning with tasks and boards. Beyond that, paid plans add the things many teams need, like approval workflows, billable rates, capacity planning, PTO, budgets and alerts, and the reporting depth that turns tracked hours into utilization and margin.
